{{small|(9 December 2018)}} | attendance = 3,101,694 | average attendance = 10,136 | prevseason = [[2017 Liga 1 (Indonesia)|2017]] | nextseason = [[2019 Liga 1 (Indonesia)|2019]] }} The '''2018 Liga 1''', also known as '''Go-Jek Liga 1''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web|title=Ini Penyebab Berubahnya Titel Sponsor Liga 1 2018|url=https://liga-indonesia.id/berita/ini-penyebab-berubahnya-titel-sponsor-liga-1-2018|website=liga-indonesia.id|access-date=22 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180805203151/https://liga-indonesia.id/berita/ini-penyebab-berubahnya-titel-sponsor-liga-1-2018|archive-date=5 August 2018|url-status=usurped}} was the 2nd season of [[Liga 1 (Indonesia)|Liga 1]] under its current name and the 9th season of the top-flight Indonesian professional league for [[association football]] clubs since its establishment in 2008. The season started on 23 March 2018 and ended on 9 December 2018.{{cite web|title=Catat, Ini Tanggal Kick Off dan Laga Pembuka Liga 1 2018 - Bola.net|url=https://www.bola.net/indonesia/catat-ini-tanggal-kick-off-dan-laga-pembuka-liga-1-2018-fa8d7c.html|website=Bola.net|access-date=8 March 2018|archive-date=3 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403215754/https://www.bola.net/indonesia/catat-ini-tanggal-kick-off-dan-laga-pembuka-liga-1-2018-fa8d7c.html|url-status=live}} Fixtures for the 2018 season were announced on 10 March 2018.{{cite web |title=Draft Jadwal Liga 1 2018 di Tangan, CEO PSM Usul Begini Soal Laga Tandang! |url=https://makassar.tribunnews.com/2018/03/11/draft-jadwal-liga-1-2018-di-tangan-ceo-psm-usul-begini-soal-laga-tandang |website=Tribun Timur |language=id-ID |access-date=2019-08-22 |archive-date=2019-08-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190822142132/https://makassar.tribunnews.com/2018/03/11/draft-jadwal-liga-1-2018-di-tangan-ceo-psm-usul-begini-soal-laga-tandang |url-status=live }} [[Bhayangkara F.C.|Bhayangkara]] were the defending champions. [[Persebaya Surabaya|Persebaya]], [[PSMS Medan|PSMS]], and [[PSIS Semarang|PSIS]] joined as the promoted teams from the [[2017 Liga 2]]. They replaced [[Persegres Gresik United|Persegres]], [[Persiba Balikpapan|Persiba]], and [[Semen Padang F.C.|Semen Padang]], which were relegated to the [[2018 Liga 2]]. [[Persija Jakarta|Persija]] won their first Liga 1 title, and second Indonesian top-flight title overall on the final day of the season, finishing on 62 points.{{cite web |title=Persija Juara Usai Taklukkan Mitra Kukar |url=https://liga-indonesia.id/berita/persija-juara-usai-taklukkan-mitra-kukar |website=liga-indonesia.id |access-date=9 December 2018 }}{{Dead link|date=June 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} ==Overview== ===Player regulations=== Player registration was divided into two periods. The first period opened from 10 February 2018 and closes on 5 April 2018.{{cite web|title=Pendaftaran Pemain Liga 1 2018 Diperpanjang {{!}} Goal.com|url=http://www.goal.com/id/berita/pendaftaran-pemain-liga-1-2018-diperpanjang/qyumpvlvtokb18r8q16v2wp6s|access-date=1 April 2018|language=id|archive-date=1 April 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180401214329/http://www.goal.com/id/berita/pendaftaran-pemain-liga-1-2018-diperpanjang/qyumpvlvtokb18r8q16v2wp6s|url-status=live}} Then the second period was done on 5 July to 3 August 2018. Clubs could register at least 18 players and a maximum of 30 players. The club was also required to contract at least seven local U-23 players (born on or after 1 January 1996). Unlike last season, U-23 players were not required to play in one game.{{cite web|title=Ini Kuota Pemain dan Regulasi Pemain Asing di Liga 1 2018|url=https://www.jawapos.com/read/2018/02/11/187959/ini-kuota-pemain-dan-regulasi-pemain-asing-di-liga-1-2018|access-date=12 February 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180212150711/https://www.jawapos.com/read/2018/02/11/187959/ini-kuota-pemain-dan-regulasi-pemain-asing-di-liga-1-2018|archive-date=12 February 2018|url-status=dead}} [[Persija Jakarta|Persija]] and [[Bali United F.C.|Bali United]] got privileges related to player quota. Both were allowed to add three local players with no age limit, following their participation in the [[2018 AFC Cup]] representing Indonesia.{{cite web|title=Operator Liga Berikan Tambahan Kuota Pemain untuk Persija dan Bali United - Bola.net|url=https://www.bola.net/indonesia/operator-liga-berikan-tambahan-kuota-pemain-untuk-persija-dan-bali-united-b05e90.html|website=Bola.net|access-date=5 March 2018|archive-date=11 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200911034341/https://www.bola.net/indonesia/operator-liga-berikan-tambahan-kuota-pemain-untuk-persija-dan-bali-united-b05e90.html|url-status=live}} ===Referee=== Unlike last season, the league operator ensured that they did not use any foreign referees for this season.{{cite web|last1=Media|first1=Kompas Cyber|title=PSSI: Wasit Asing Tak Akan Pimpin Pertandingan Liga 1 2018, tetapi... - Kompas.com|url=https://bola.kompas.com/read/2018/03/29/18050048/pssi--wasit-asing-tak-akan-pimpin-pertandingan-liga-1-2018-tetapi-|website=KOMPAS.com|access-date=30 March 2018|language=en|archive-date=6 March 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220306010119/https://bola.kompas.com/read/2018/03/29/18050048/pssi--wasit-asing-tak-akan-pimpin-pertandingan-liga-1-2018-tetapi-|url-status=live}} ==Teams== Eighteen teams competed in the league – the top fifteen teams from the previous season and three teams promoted from the [[2017 Liga 2|Liga 2]]. The new teams this season were [[Persebaya Surabaya|Persebaya]], [[PSMS Medan|PSMS]], and [[PSIS Semarang|PSIS]], who replaced [[Persegres Gresik United|Persegres]], [[Persiba Balikpapan|Persiba]],
